description: Header file defining the ARTPConnection class for managing RTP/RTCP streams in Android's media framework.

classes.name: ARTPConnection
classes.description: Class managing RTP/RTCP stream connections, including socket creation, stream management, and packet parsing.

methods.name: addStream
methods.description: Adds an RTP/RTCP stream with specified sockets and session description.

methods.name: injectPacket
methods.description: Injects a packet into the stream.

methods.name: setSelfID
methods.description: Sets the identifier for this connection.

methods.name: setStaticJitterTimeMs
methods.description: Sets static jitter buffer time in milliseconds.

methods.name: setIsIPv6
methods.description: Sets whether the connection uses IPv6.

methods.name: MakePortPair
methods.description: Creates a pair of UDP sockets bound to adjacent ports.

methods.name: MakeRTPSocketPair
methods.description: Creates a pair of UDP sockets bound to specified IPs and ports.
